description: Centralized AI tool configuration hub — single source of truth for prompts, contexts, commands, rules, skills, agents, and provider adapters across AI coding tools.

validated_local_contracts.note: Claude settings stay hand-managed, but these access fields are validated as part of the adapter contract.

auto_discovery.antigravity_skills: Auto-discovers from ~/.agents/skills/ as the user-scope alias — no ~/.gemini/skills symlink needed
auto_discovery.nemoclaw_skills: Auto-discovers from /sandbox/.agents/skills/ inside the sandbox — synced by sync.sh sync-nemoclaw-skills

mcp.contract: Tool-native MCP support; hub policy stays in prompts/commands/rules

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and shared handoffs

settings.contract: ~/.claude/settings.json remains local config but must preserve required ~/.agents access fields while keeping hook, statusline, and plugin ownership local

commands.contract: No hub-managed Codex-native command bridge in this repo

mcp.contract: Tool-native MCP configured outside the hub

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and shared handoffs

hooks.contract: OpenCode upstream supports plugin event hooks, but this repo does not manage an OpenCode hook bridge yet

mcp.contract: Tool-native MCP support when configured by the operator

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and shared handoffs

memory.contract: Explicit memory bridge parity only: use gsd memory-sync from the bridged command surface or run ~/.agents/scripts/memory-sync-bridge.mjs directly for status, recall, and flush

skills.contract: Auto-discovers user skills from ~/.agents/skills without a mirrored ~/.gemini/skills directory

commands.contract: Generated TOML commands from ~/.agents/commands via sync.sh gen-antigravity-commands with Gemini path rewriting

agents.contract: Generated from ~/.agents/agents via sync.sh gen-antigravity-agents into Gemini-compatible agent frontmatter

hooks.contract: Gemini CLI upstream supports extensions and hook-like automation surfaces, but this repo does not manage an Antigravity hook bridge yet

mcp.contract: Gemini CLI upstream supports MCP, but this repo does not manage an Antigravity MCP contract yet

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and shared handoffs

memory.contract: Explicit memory bridge parity only: use gsd memory-sync from the generated command surface or run ~/.agents/scripts/memory-sync-bridge.mjs directly for status, recall, and flush

commands.contract: OpenClaw upstream supports slash commands and plugin-provided commands, but this repo does not manage an OpenClaw-native command bridge yet

agents.contract: No hub-managed OpenClaw agent generation contract in this repo

hooks.contract: OpenClaw upstream supports hooks, but this repo does not manage an OpenClaw hook bridge yet

mcp.contract: No hub-managed OpenClaw MCP contract in this repo

session_continuity.contract: Shared continuity helpers write project-local runtime state and shared handoffs

memory.contract: Explicit memory bridge parity only: use ~/.agents/scripts/memory-sync-bridge.mjs directly for status, recall, and flush because this repo does not bridge OpenClaw commands

workspace_wrappers.contract: Generated workspace wrappers from ~/.agents via sync.sh gen-openclaw-workspace

generated.note: OpenCode agents are generated from hub agent markdown into OpenCode-compatible frontmatter.

Antigravity requires .toml (description + prompt fields). Hub stores commands as .md with YAML frontmatter. Run 'sync.sh gen-antigravity-commands' or 'sync.sh migrate' to regenerate after hub command changes.
Antigravity agents are generated from the hub agent definitions into Gemini-compatible agent files with translated frontmatter and Gemini-native tool names.
OpenClaw workspace wrappers preserve tool-local identity while pointing back to the hub as the workflow source.
Skills are pushed into the NemoClaw sandbox at /sandbox/.agents/skills/ where OpenClaw auto-discovers them as personal agent skills. Run after npx skills add or sandbox restart.
